blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—June Mar Fajardo is honored to become the latest member of the PBA’s 10,000-point club, which he achieved during San Miguel Beer’s comeback win over NLEX on Wednesday here. Fajardo is the 19th player ever to reach the career milestone, something that was not on his mind when he first made it to the league as the No. 1 overall pick in the 2012 Rookie Draft.
